async function runCompany(name,rank=0){const A=eval(load("internationalAtsHelpers")),W=A.W;const r=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -c "+W.q("import json; q=json.load(open('job-search/discovery/application-queue.json')); print(json.dumps(next(j for j in q if j['company']=="+JSON.stringify(name)+" and j['company_rank']=="+rank+")))"),workdir:W.ROOT,max_output_tokens:16000});const j=JSON.parse(r.output);const guard=await tools.exec_command({cmd:"./.venv/bin/python scripts/check-company-limit.py "+W.q(name),workdir:W.ROOT,max_output_tokens:300});if(guard.exit_code)throw Error(guard.output);const card={...j,href:j.url,text:j.title,card:j.title+"

"+j.company+"

"+j.location};store("internationalCurrent",card);let result;try{result=card.provider==="greenhouse"?await eval(load("internationalGhHelpers")).gh(card):await A.ats(card)}catch(e){result={error:String(e)};text({company:name,error:String(e)})}await W.H.saveJSON("job-search/discovery/current-attempt.json",{...j,id:W.ident(j.url),result,note:result===true?"Confirmed submission":result?.error||"Required form fields or choices need review; not submitted."});text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"./.venv/bin/python scripts/log-international-attempt.py job-search/discovery/current-attempt.json",workdir:W.ROOT,max_output_tokens:300}));return result}runCompany
